descripcion: Parity cases Python <-> JS for the 'unusual' flag U1 + I2 (ADR-0006 rule 6c-q). Python reference: src/nucleo/validacion_marca.py.
marca_si: SI-generated (AI): Claude Code generated this file during the event; reviewed by the team.

regla.cuantil: type 6: x sorted ascending, N=len; h=(N+1)*p; if h<=1 -> x[0]; if h>=N -> x[N-1]; else j=floor(h), g=h-j, q = x[j-1] + g*(x[j]-x[j-1]) (0-indexed array, exactly this expression)
regla.u1: high if v > p90 (strict); else low if p10 > 0 and v < p10 (strict); else none
regla.i2: evaluate u1 at lo and hi; both high -> unusual/high; both low -> unusual/low; both none -> typical; else possibly_unusual (direccion = the flagged side, or 'both')
regla.observado: lo = hi = null -> use the value itself
regla.texto_razon: toFixed(1) of razon + '× the <base> median' (Python uses ROUND_HALF_UP on the exact binary value = JS toFixed)
regla.temporada: inusual = acumulado > p90 type 6 of base cumulatives at same day (strict); base empty -> insufficient
regla.anio_fuego: month after the first minimum of the 12 monthly medians (1..12)

exactitud: every decision uses the EXACT rational type-6 threshold (Python fractions.Fraction with p = 1/10, 1/2, 9/10; JS BigInt); reported p10/mediana/p90 are the nearest doubles and are never used to decide. Cases with tipo 'exact_tie' have the value or an interval end equal to the exact threshold (N = 13 and N = 14).
nota_datos: REAL observed cases use NASA FIRMS VIIRS standard detections (S-NPP to 2018-03, NOAA-20 from 2018-04), outside the static mask, 2012-02 to 2018-12 only; base = same calendar month in the other 2012-2018 years. REAL harmonized cases are MODIS (Terra/Aqua, standard, outside mask) detections of 2011 (Terra+Aqua) and 2001 (Terra only) weighted with the final factors (calibrated 2012-02..2018-12) via pesos_modis, with the 80% interval of intervalos_<pais>.json at level 'aoi'; base = same month 2012-2018 VIIRS. Cases labelled SYNTHETIC are invented inputs for edge cases; they are not observations.
